notes.title: 🎉 25,000 Players!! 🎉
notes.notes:
[p]🎉 [b]25,000 Players!![/b] 🎉[/p][p]We’re beyond excited to share that our game [i]“Is This A Platformer?”[/i] has now been downloaded by over [b]25,000 players[/b] worldwide!
From the bottom of our hearts — [b]thank you[/b] for the love, support, memes, and chaos 💜[/p][p]If you’ve had a chance to play it, we’d love to hear what you think. Even a short review helps us grow and reach more players. 💬[/p][p][/p][p]This is just the beginning. Let’s see how far we can go together.[/p][p]— TLD Team 💥[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44969179/15c3e4c4a3277cfac1252134992ee2f8924717be.jpg"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Help Us By Reviewing Our Game ✅
notes.notes:
[p]We've seen many players enjoying our game, and I'm truly touched.
Thank you so much! 🙏[/p][p]If you have a moment, could you leave a Steam review?
Your review means a lot to me and really helps me make better games.[/p][p][b]Even one short line is appreciated![/b]
I'd love to hear your thoughts 💬[/p][p]Thanks again.
– TLD Team

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44969179/7a0d22a931f42f1bab02a80d657529c78f99d705.jpg"][/img][/p]

notes.title: 🎉 15,000 Players?! You Guys Are Unreal
notes.notes:
[p]🎉We just hit [b]15,000 players[/b] on [i]Is This A Platformer?
[/i][/p][p]We launched with a weird idea, a lot of coffee, and zero expectations… and now here we are, watching thousands of you dive headfirst into this chaotic, rule-breaking world we built.
[/p][p]To every one of you who downloaded, shared or reviewed the game [b]thank you[/b].

Your support means everything. The reviews, the memes, the feedback — we’re reading all of it, and it’s fueling us to go even harder.[/p][p][/p][p]Much love,
[b]TLD Team[/b]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44969179/ec82b9db6931cc95184ab5d724a5f758d55bf1d7.jpg"][/img][/p]

notes.title: 🚨 We just hit 6,000 downloads!
notes.notes:
[h3]🚨 We just hit [b]6,000 downloads[/b]![/h3][p][/p][p]I made [i]Is This A Platformer?[/i] solo, and now thousands of people have it in their Steam library — this feels surreal.
[/p][p]Thank you so much to everyone who's checking it out. If you’ve played it and enjoyed it, a short review helps a lot. ❤️

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44969179/40f21154a91ff3a1632a44c905fd162e4803e827.jpg"][/img][/p]

notes.title: 1st anniversary
notes.notes:
To celebrate the [b] 1st anniversary [/b] of Is This a Platformer? and to express our gratitude to our community, we’re making the game permanently free on Steam.

Thanks to your support, we’ve been able to cover the production costs and move forward with the development of our next title. This milestone wouldn’t have been possible without you.

If you haven’t had the chance to play the game yet, we hope you’ll take this opportunity to dive in and experience it. Thank you for being part of our journey.

— TLD Team
